svg.title: At secondary level the gap between gross and net rates is much wider than in primary school in some countries
svg.desc: Table: At secondary level the gap between gross and net rates is much wider than in primary school in some countries: Gap: Belgium: 63.8, Finland: 57.5, Australia: 61.3, Türkiye: 25.8, OECD: 17.4, Germany: 15.8, World: 8.7, US: 6.5; Vs primary: Belgium: 59.8, Finland: 56.6, Australia: 57.1, Türkiye: 16.2, OECD: 10.6, Germany: 4.2, World: −3.8, US: −0.7.
